atAGlance: Lẩu nấm chay is vegetarian mushroom hot pot, usually with mixed mushrooms, tofu, greens, noodles, and vegetable broth.
whatItIs: Lẩu nấm chay is vegetarian mushroom hot pot with vegetable broth, mixed mushrooms, tofu, greens, herbs, and noodles. It is earthy, light, and shared at the table.
howToEnjoy: Cook mushrooms and greens in stages, then add noodles near the end. Ask about fish sauce or meat broth if strict vegetarian eating matters.
howLocalsOrder: Order lẩu nấm chay by table size, and ask for no fish sauce or vegetarian broth if the broth needs to be fully vegetarian.
worthKnowing: In Vietnamese chay hot pot, mushrooms bring the depth, so the pot can feel satisfying without meat when the broth is clean and aromatic.
goodToKnow: Ask whether the hot-pot broth is vegetable-based and whether the table dips are vegetarian.
travelerCaution: Confirm the broth and table dips are vegetarian if strict.
